title: 目標達成の後に・Open Horizon

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Um, I've decided which race I'd like to run first!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion's training is progressing without issue. By now, she's strengthened her body enough to participate in even the most intense races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just as I was thinking of contacting her to find out her goals so I could put together a schedule, she contacted me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I want to run in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: My heart was pounding so hard when I watched that race…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: All of the runners looked so beautiful and proud as they ran.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I used to think that anything would be fine as long as I could run, but this is the first race I've felt particularly strongly about.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I just know there must be something special about it, and I'd like to discover what it is for myself!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Not to mention, a G1 would make wonderful news for everyone back home.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I wouldn't be here right now without everyone's understanding and support.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I have to return home with my head held high if I wish to show them my gratitude.
choice_data_list: Then it's settled. Our long-term objective is the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.
Then it's settled. Our long-term objective is the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Our long-term objective? …Oh, I see. It's still a long way off, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: What kind of path do people normally take leading up to it?
choice_data_list: I'd say most people compete in the Triple Tiara tour.
I'd say most people compete in the Triple Tiara tour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Triple Tiara tour is comprised of three grandiose races that can only be joined in one's classic year—the Oka Sho, the Japanese Oaks, and the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Is that right?! Then, perhaps I should as well. I wouldn't want to buck tradition, now. ♪
choice_data_list: We can give it a shot, but…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion didn't originally plan on having a racing career when she joined Tracen Academy, so she has had far less time to train than the others in her year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rather than push herself in the spring races where the ability gap will still be large, I suggest we hone her skills through the summer and begin racing in earnest come autumn.
choice_data_list: But it's ultimately up to you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Then, there's only one answer! I want to run in the spring!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Now that I can race, I simply must take on as many as possible!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Besides, performing on such a grand stage should show me should show me a truly wonderful view, don't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I see. My heart can pound even harder…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Wonderful views, huh?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You weren't lying when you said it would be even better than now, right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I want to know more. I want to experience everything that racing has to offer!
choice_data_list: I'm sure you'll discover joys you could never find anywhere else.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Okay, it's decided then! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'm going to run in the Triple Tiara tour and then the Queen Elizabeth II Cup!
choice_data_list: First up is the Oka Sho in the spring!
First up is the Oka Sho in the spring!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Right!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, we've decided that our next race goal is the Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Spring… I'm sure it will be here in the blink of an eye. I have to make sure to cherish each and every moment.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: When can we see the cherry blossoms? If I were to plant a tree in your office, then—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'm kidding, of course.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It was just a joke…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Aha, you got me! Okay, okay. ♪
